description: Compares two birth charts: the aspects between the planets (and ascendant and midheaven when known) of the two people, the most exact first, and each person's planets in the other's houses. Each person is an object with date, time (optional), place (or lat, lon, tz) and name (optional). Calculations only, no reading of the relationship; the link opens the double chart on the site.

place.description: A town or city, e.g. "Opole", "Kraków", "London"; the first match is used (Polish places come first)

time.description: Clock time at the place of birth, HH:MM; leave out if unknown

tz.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Warsaw (with lat and lon)
